method: One PSCompPars row per planet. Spectral label first letter, case insensitive; compact remnants separately via PSR hostname or WD/DC/DQ/DA/DB/DO/DZ labels. Missing labels retained; no temperature-to-class imputation. All archived confirmed rows included, including literature-controversy flags. Sample values from one selected PS reference per planet.

queries.sample_ps_query: select pl_name,hostname,pl_refname,default_flag,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_rade,pl_radeerr1,pl_radeerr2,pl_radelim,pl_bmasse,pl_bmasseerr1,pl_bmasseerr2,pl_bmasselim,pl_bmassprov,pl_insol,pl_insolerr1,pl_insolerr2,pl_insollim,st_teff,st_spectype,pl_orbsmax,st_lum from ps where pl_name in ('TRAPPIST-1 e','TRAPPIST-1 f','TRAPPIST-1 g','Proxima Cen b','LHS 1140 b','TOI-700 d','TOI-700 e','Kepler-186 f','Kepler-62 f')

TRAPPIST-1.method: Published rounded illustrative orbital interval 0.024–0.049 AU (Gillon 2016), converted using Agol 2021 log L=-3.25727. No polynomial extrapolation below 2600 K.

Proxima Cen.method: Kopparapu et al. 2014, one Earth mass; conservative runaway/maximum greenhouse and optimistic recent Venus/early Mars.

LHS 1140.method: Kopparapu et al. 2014, one Earth mass; conservative runaway/maximum greenhouse and optimistic recent Venus/early Mars.

TOI-700.method: Kopparapu et al. 2014, one Earth mass; conservative runaway/maximum greenhouse and optimistic recent Venus/early Mars.

Kepler-62.method: Kopparapu et al. 2014, one Earth mass; conservative runaway/maximum greenhouse and optimistic recent Venus/early Mars.
